parameters.query: SELECT action, target, decision, result, decided_at FROM tlab_audit WHERE decided_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY decided_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT container, issue_type, root_cause, solution, outcome, confidence FROM tlab_memory WHERE (container = '{{ ($json.query?.target || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' OR container = 'system') AND outcome = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY learned_at DESC LIMIT 3;
